newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ public opposition to compulsory super builds.
newsitem.headline: NZ public opposition to compulsory super builds.

text.p: Public support for a proposed Compulsory superannuation scheme has slumped in recent months with most people saying they would vote against the concept, according to a poll released on Friday.
The National Business Review-Consultus poll showed that, in three months of tracking public opinion, support for compulsory superannuation has gone from 48 percent in March to 28 percent.
Opposition has meanwhile risen from 35 percent in March to 58 percent.
Unsure or uncommitted voters made up 15 percent of the 750 people polled.
The margin of error was 3.5 percent.
The public is due to vote on a compulsory superannuation scheme in September. Details of the scheme will be released in early July.
